description:
Hee-wook, a well-known small and medium-sized idol two-planet leader and main vocalist, thought things would get better in the future. Even if a popular visual member left the team or the hiatus was long due to the coronavirus, everyone would do well in the end. He reassured himself. However, the reality he encountered after being discharged from the military was that the team was disbanded. He was unemployed. Hee-wook looked for a drama audition room to hold on to something and ran into top star Cheon Kyung-seo there. “As the situation got difficult, his expression and tone of voice became stiff, and so on?”
